name: InvestLens
purpose: A Shanghai Stock Exchange research memo: pick a company from a bundled sample universe and read independently sourced panels — price history, valuation metrics against cohort medians, peer comparison, attributed brokerage opinions and stored headlines — next to a portfolio lens that values holdings with the same closes.
inputs: Company selection from the bundled 8-company SSE sample universe (ticker, name or industry search)
Portfolio holdings with symbol, units, cost per unit and current price per unit, plus cash in CNY
outputs: Price history chart with window statistics
Valuation and quality metric cards with sample-universe cohort medians
Brokerage research summary with rating distribution and target midpoints

outputDetails.Price history chart with window statisti: Deterministic sample close series generated per ticker, drawn as an SVG line; latest close, daily change and max drawdown are computed from that series. Clearly stamped as samples, never live quotes; upgrades to the platform market.prices series when capability access is granted.
outputDetails.Valuation and quality metric cards with: P/E, P/S, dividend yield, ROE, revenue growth and interest coverage from the bundled record; amber markers show same-industry medians of the sample universe. Missing fields render N/A with a reason, never zero.
outputDetails.Industry peer comparison table: Same-industry rows within the bundled sample with a cohort median row; not an industry or market benchmark.
outputDetails.Brokerage research summary with rating d: Fictional brokerages bundled for layout; rating counts are brokerages, and the average midpoint is presented as a price comparison, not a forecast return or advice.
outputDetails.Stored company and industry headlines: Static sample headlines attributed to fictional publishers, shown as text; the sandbox cannot open outbound links and story timing is not claimed to move prices.
outputDetails.Portfolio valuation summary: Units-times-price position values, invested cost, profit excluding cash, return percentage and largest-position concentration, mirroring the verified portfolio calculation contract; shared platform inputs replace the bundled holdings when available.

constraints: CNY reporting with 万/亿 display units
Every figure carries its source stamp; bundled sample data is never presented as live market data
No trading or investment advice; brokerage views are attributed third-party opinions
Historical sample observations only; no forecasts
Self-contained in the platform sandbox; no network, imports or embedded credentials
